name: Acme Corp
description: Synthetic mid-sized company profile for the Kitaru compliance review example.

sections.title: Company overview
sections.content: Acme Corp provides logistics automation software to enterprise customers. The company depends on cloud-hosted systems, third-party suppliers, and a hybrid workforce across Europe and North America.

sections.title: Compliance review scope
sections.content: The current review covers employment policies, SOC 2-style security controls, vendor contract clauses, insurance coverage, financial statement consistency, privacy controls, and disaster recovery readiness.

sections.title: Known risk areas
sections.content: The highest-risk areas for this synthetic review are people policy freshness, data retention and incident response procedures, vendor liability protections, cyber incident insurance coverage, revenue reporting consistency, and cloud failover readiness.
